_help.about: Dead wood placed at world generation (design reconciliation, seeded now; the decay simulation comes with Phase 6/7): a share of trees stand dead (snags: no leaves, grey bark, brittle handholds), and dead culms stand among living bamboo. Restart after editing. Old growth (data/stand.json): a primeval stand carries more standing dead wood than a managed one, so the default share is 0.06 (was 0.03).
_help.share: The share of trees that are dead, by biome key; default for the rest.
_help.bamboo_share: The share of bamboo culms that are dead (dry, straw colored, they shatter).
_help.decay_stage: The one decay stage every dead tree is placed at for now (fresh, barked, bare, hollow, rotten); the ledgers will move it later.
